description: This file contains a series of test scripts written in shell script for testing 'git clone' command with various '--revision' options and related parameters. The tests verify cloning behavior with different revision inputs such as branch names, tags, head, commit hashes, trees, and combinations with other options like '--depth', '--bare', etc.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to execute after the test completes for cleanup or other purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified options and message.
